Why Korean beauty

Innovation you can see on your skin

Korea has become one of the world's most influential beauty markets, known for innovation, skincare technology, ingredient-focused products and constantly evolving beauty trends.

We do more than import cosmetics. We discover emerging beauty trends, curate products, educate consumers and create a platform where customers can explore Korean beauty with confidence.

Policy

Return & Refund Policy

7-day easy returns

If a product arrives damaged, incorrect, or unopened and unused, you may request a return within 7 days of delivery for a replacement or refund.

What can't be returned

For hygiene reasons, opened or used skincare, makeup, and personal care items cannot be returned unless the product itself is defective.

How to request a return

Email support@firstfan.pk with your order number and photos of the item. Our team will confirm eligibility and share pickup or drop-off instructions.

Refund timeline

Approved refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to your original payment method, or as store credit if you paid via Cash on Delivery.

Policy

Privacy Policy

Information we collect

We collect the details you provide at checkout or sign-up — name, phone number, delivery address and email — to process orders and provide support.

How we use your data

Your information is used to fulfil orders, send delivery updates, and — only with your consent — share offers and new product launches.

Payment security

Card and mobile-wallet payments are processed through secure, PCI-compliant gateways. FIRST FAN never stores your full card details.

Your rights

You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting support@firstfan.pk.
